observations: No production bug found in Phase 2 code; every success criterion was met.
The grading cache key embeds windowDays although the backlog is point-in-time and window independent: three entries per tenant instead of one (harmless fragmentation, same as the monthly series).
The grading section mixes a up-to-30s cached backlog with a live reportsAwaitingPublication count (by design in the plan); a user can briefly see an updated report count next to a stale backlog.

reportsAwaitingPublication counts every unpublished attempt_reports row of the tenant, including reports created lazily when a host merely viewed an attempt before publish (see AttemptReport javadoc); it is not restricted to graded attempts.
The subscription lookup sorts the tenant's usable subscriptions (top-N heapsort, 111 rows in the seed); acceptable because a tenant holds few subscriptions, no extra index is warranted.
Fixture numbers for the cross-tenant assertions are deliberately 5-digit values (70707 ...) because repeated-digit values such as 7777 collide with the repeated-digit UUID fixtures in the JSON body.
Mockito prints the 'dynamic agent' warning in this JDK; unrelated to the tests.
